ui.title_cos: Lead Title, Landmark Abstract, Trident Land Transfer, all in the Philadelphia area
ui.law: Pennsylvania lets you assign a purchase contract; put the assignment right in the contract and never market the house itself. Philadelphia also requires a wholesaler license from L&I (Wholesale Residential Real Property Business License) and a written disclosure to the seller before signing. Foreclosure is judicial, so filings are public at the Court of Common Pleas.
ui.groups: "DIG (Diversified Investors Group)", "Philadelphia Real Estate Investors", "Philly Wholesale Deals"
ui.prefc: L&I cases: the city posts every open Licenses and Inspections case. Unsafe structure means an inspector found the building a danger; a court case means L&I is suing the owner; a vacant property violation means the owner is paying for an empty house. Sealed and vacant come from the assessor's own exterior inspection.
ui.buyers_note: Companies that bought 2 or more houses in the last 18 months, from the city sale data, most active first. Skip the big institutions and builders; the 2 to 20 purchase LLCs are the ones who buy wholesale deals. Look up the owner on the PA business search and call.
ui.buyers_empty: No buyers found in the sale data yet.
ui.repairs: Repairs, Philadelphia rough numbers per rowhouse: cosmetic 12-20k, kitchen+baths 25-45k, roof (flat, rubber) 6-12k, heater 5-9k, brick repointing and lintels 5-15k, full gut 50-90k.
ui.sources: Philadelphia Office of Property Assessment parcel layer (owner, mailing address, market value, sale, exterior condition), L&I unsafe structures, demolitions, violations and vacancy indicators, city delinquent tax list
